research Challenges.publiclyAvailableEmails: Very few PE firms publish direct partner emails on their websites. Most use generic contact@ or info@ addresses.
research Challenges.dataAggregatorLimitation: Per instructions, cannot use RocketReach/ZoomInfo inferred emails - only publicly published sources.
research Challenges.apolloAPIIssue: Apollo organization search failed to find most firms in database.
research Challenges.serviceProviderMisclassification: Significant portion of 'PE firms' in sheet are actually service providers (recruiters, advisors, law firms, hedge funds).

recommendations: Clean the master list to remove non-PE firms (recruiters, advisors, law firms, hedge funds)
For firms with only generic emails (info@, ir@, contact@), consider LinkedIn outreach or using Apollo person search with firmographics
Focus enrichment efforts on mid-market PE firms ($500M-$5B AUM) as they tend to have better online presence
Consider using press releases and conference speaker lists as sources for published contact info
